definition.short: A round fruit with red or green skin
definition.long: A round fruit with red or green skin and firm white flesh that grows on trees. One of the most common and widely cultivated fruits in the world.

definition.short: Move at a speed faster than walking
definition.long: Move at a speed faster than a walk, never having both feet on the ground at the same time. A fundamental human movement used in exercise, sports, and daily activities.

definition.short: Open to more than one interpretation
definition.long: Open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning. Often used to describe statements or situations that are unclear or can be understood in multiple ways.

entries.sentence_frame: The politician's response was _____, leaving voters unsure of his true intentions.

definition.short: A written or printed work consisting of pages
definition.long: A written or printed work consisting of pages glued or sewn together along one side and bound in covers. A medium for recording information in the form of writing or images.
Well-meaning and kindly; charitable. Often used to describe someone who desires to do good and help others, or an organization that operates for charitable purposes.

entries.sentence_frame: The _____ donor gave millions to help build schools in developing countries.

definition.long: Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. A positive emotional state characterized by feelings of joy, satisfaction, and well-being.

definition.short: Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing
definition.long: Fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing; clearly expressing or indicating something. Describes communication that is powerful, moving, and effectively conveys meaning.

entries.sentence_frame: Her _____ speech moved the audience to tears.
